prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pick Your Companion Path", "Choose whether you want to adopt a ready mascot or customize your own desktop pet.", "Select Path"]
1: ["Save Your New Companion", "Sign in to secure your pet data and sync across sessions."]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Learn how to summon, move, and customize your desktop pet anytime.", "Click to Pet • Right-Click Menu • Drag to Move", "Got It!"]
3: ["Create Custom Pet from Photos", "Upload clear, well-lit photos of your pet for best render quality.", "Clear face photo • Well lit • No background clutter"]
4: ["Signing in ensures your pet state, level, and memories are safely backed up."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Assets...", "Allocating overlay • Loading animations • Spawning desktop pet"]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially ready for your desktop background!"]
7: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion in Seconds", "Choose a pre-made pet for instant fun or design your own custom desktop pet.", "Start Choice"]
8: ["Welcome Home! Your Pet is Ready", "Press Option/Alt + P anytime to bring up pet controls.", "Unlocked: Quick Pet Shortcut Hotkey"]
9: ["Select Your Preset Desktop Mascot", "Choose Companion"]
